ITEM 1 | Bright green broccoli florets, several clusters with a dark green to yellow-green tone, some tips slightly browned and charred, firm stems with a fibrous texture, dry surface with no visible sauce, spread across the upper-middle of the plate covering roughly 25% of the plate's area, florets about 2-4 cm across and stems about 1 cm thick, sitting directly on the plate | 95

ITEM 2 | Two breaded or crumbed fish-like pieces, golden-tan to brown crust with a grainy, crispy-looking surface and some darker browned edges, one piece roughly 7 cm long by 3 cm wide, the other about 8 cm by 3.5 cm, moderate thickness about 1.5-2 cm, pale flaky interior partly visible at cut edge, dry surface, lying side by side in the lower-middle of the plate covering roughly 15% of the plate | 120

ITEM 3 | Two small pieces of seared meat with a brown exterior and pinkish-red interior, one piece about 5 cm by 3 cm, the other about 4.5 cm by 3 cm, thickness about 1.5 cm, moist-looking surface with slight sheen, firm texture with visible grain, placed on the right edge of the plate covering roughly 8% of the plate | 80
